versions.content: Name Bmc_AtomicSType Kind Type Derived from sint Range - – The Bmc_AtomicSType shall always be mapped to a platform specific type where atomic operations can be realized by the respective HW platform, to ensure that all the operations performed on this type are lock-free Description The type shall be used for all signed data items, which are used for Bmc library functions. Available via Bmc.h
